test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

A ten-year-old girl was taking art classes for children.

options.text: Art classes for children had been taken by a ten-year-old girl.
Art classes for children were taken by a ten-year-old girl.
Children for art classes were being taken by a ten-year-old girl.
Art classes for children were being taken by a ten-year-old girl.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Art classes for children were being taken by a ten-year-old girl'.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Passive Form. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'past continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (Objective Case) + was/were+ being + V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He was riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike was being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
• Here, in the given sentence 'was taking' will be changed into 'were being taken'. 
 
• **'Art classes for children'** will be changed into the **subject**.
 
• 'A ten-year-old girl' will be changed into the object. 
 
• The preposition 'by' will be added. 

 
 
 

​Correct Sentence:__ Art classes for children were being taken by a ten-year-old girl.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

 
• दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें वाक्य को Passive form में बदलना है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य 'past continuous' का उदाहरण है।
 
• इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है:
 
 
• Subject +was/were + V1+ing +Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+was/were+ being+ V3+ by +Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He was riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike was being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
• यहां, दिए गए वाक्य में 'was taking' को 'were being taken' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• 'Art classes for children' को subject में बदल दिया जाएगा। 
 
• **'A ten-year-old girl'** को **object** में बदला जाएगा।
 
• पूर्वसर्ग '**by**' जोड़ा जाएगा।
